responsibility: Generates a C header fragment defining SYSROOT_SUFFIX_SPEC from a target’s multilib description. Given MULTILIB_OSDIRNAMES, MULTILIB_OPTIONS, MULTILIB_MATCHES, and MULTILIB_REUSE, the script recursively enumerates multilib option combinations, folds identical subtrees, applies directory-name matches and reuse mappings, and emits the resulting GCC spec string as a #define. Its responsibility is build-time generation of sysroot-suffix specs from multilib configuration data.
